ALLIENT INC is a public company headquartered in Williamsville, NY, trading under ticker ALNT with CIK 0000046129. Its website, alantra.com, presents the firm as Alantra, an international financial services firm with over 500 professionals across EMEA, the Americas, and Asia. The site says the company provides investment banking and alternative asset management services to corporations, family-owned companies, and institutional investors, and describes a listed partnership model.

The website text does not mention any AI-specific products or services. The available information does not list any products or MCP servers for the company. The company has a New York law exposure count of 448, and no litigation cases are recorded.
